purpose: Numerical appendix for new trained checkpoints; no claim of recovering or repairing old checkpoints

scope.checkpoint_source: Only the already sealed validation selection; no reselection by this appendix

diagnostic_data.sequence: All 32 external ticks, including every visible query
diagnostic_data.target_use: Query-masked cross entropy objective only; targets never passed as model inputs
diagnostic_data.preserve_inputs: Registered FP32 inputs and dt are promoted exactly for FP64; labels stay int64

end_to_end.objective: Mean cross entropy over targets != -100 on the four fixed training episodes
end_to_end.model_mode: eval; gradients enabled; no optimizer, clipping, dropout or parameter update
end_to_end.initial_state: Production learned parameter-dependent initialization, no state detach
end_to_end.reference_rule: If the fixed h/2 vs h/4 consistency gate fails, report reference_unresolved; do not add adaptive meshes or label h/4 a continuous truth

independent_flow.subset_rule: Both arms, both tasks, both regimes at predeclared seed 81301; eight aliases before physical deduplication
independent_flow.sequence: All 32 external ticks of the registered first training episode
independent_flow.parameter_snapshot: flow.named_parameters order; model flow. prefix removed; weights loaded as stored FP32 then exactly promoted
independent_flow.objective: audit.numpy_loss of the complete v/q/z trace; this is not end-to-end CE

directions.distribution: iid normal, each vector normalized to unit L2

oracle.method: independent NumPy parameter/channel/RHS implementation and SciPy DOP853

independent_flow.reference_rule: Oracle state and finite-difference consistency must pass before claiming flow qualification; otherwise reference_unresolved
limitations: Four parameter directions do not certify the full continuous-time Jacobian
Flow-only DOP is distinct from end-to-end CE mesh diagnostics
One trajectory does not certify the whole learned parameter domain

execution.preferred_run_before: Test scoring; the runner never reads test data or test score files
execution.source_binding: Bind immutable core protocol, source hashes, freeze seal and this appendix source snapshot at registration
execution.outputs: Separate immutable numerical receipts and raw arrays, never overwrite a checkpoint or selection
execution.failure_policy: Retain failed/unresolved flags and all available raw arrays; no parameter changes, retraining, checkpoint exclusion, reselection or replacement of primary test scores

interpretation: All numerical thresholds classify this appendix only and are not additional model-selection criteria
A small aggregate gradient error cannot hide a failing boundary parameter group
Near-zero reference gradients use the declared absolute denominator floor and retain their raw norms
Finite-mesh agreement is not an analytic continuous-time solution
Results apply to these newly trained checkpoints and fixed training probes, not the unavailable old checkpoints
